messages:
maria: Quick check — who’s owning the 15:00 release train today? we have svc-auth, svc-api, web, and infra-config in the manifest. Need smoke owners + rollback ready.

jlee: i'll take svc-api (build green). tag: release/v1.42.3

kevin: taking web. will run the smoke harness after rollout.

elaine: i can do infra-config + watch for k8s rollout issues. will skip DB migrations until after canary.

sarah: i can run smoke for svc-auth and do quick perf checks. ping me 14:55.

maria: thanks — @jlee @kevin @elaine @sarah please add your expected window. we aim for 3min per service, 10min buffer for canary.

jlee: svc-api 15:00-15:06 (canary 1 pod -> 3 pods), rollback: kubectl rollout undo deployment/svc-api --to-revision=2

kevin: web 15:06-15:10, smoke script: 
```
./smoke/run_smoke.sh --target web --timeout 120
```

elaine: infra-config 15:10-15:15. runbook: check configmap hash, watch pods restart. if image fails, revert configmap and redeploy previous job.

sarah: svc-auth 15:15-15:20. smoke checklist: auth/login, token-refresh, e2e login->call API. I'll post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder: preflight checks passed. Canaries: enabled. Health monitor: Enabled. Estimated token spend: low. :white_check_mark:

maria: ok, backups verified? @dbops

dbops: Backups verified at 14:40. no schema changes in this train.

maria: great. if anyone needs an emergency rollback, shout here. Will start the runbook at 14:58 and handoff to @oncall at 15:25.

jlee: posting smoke results now: svc-api canary looks clean. latency within 95th baseline.

kevin: web smoke passed, minor asset cache miss (expected). :thumbsup:

sarah: svc-auth smoke failed on token-refresh intermittently — retrying. updating.

elaine: infra-config applied, no restarts beyond expected. monitoring looks stable.

sarah: update: token-refresh fixed by env var tweak. smoke green. tagging in sentry no new regressions.

maria: awesome. final roll: roll forward. thanks team. I'll close the train and file the deploy note.

kevin: nice ship :ship:
